color.description: An opaque 24-bit sRGB color encoded as red × 65536 + green × 256 + blue, with each channel from 0 through 255.

contactLink.description: A channel for contacting the event or subject.

use.description: Whether this contact channel is intended for emergencies or non-emergency matters.

day.description: A calendar day in the event's declared time zone, used when an exact instant is not appropriate or not yet known.

value.description: A calendar date written as YYYY-MM-DD.

eventPlaceCamping.description: A camping destination within an event.

eventPlaceEntrance.description: An entrance or gate within an event.

eventPlaceInfo.description: An information point within an event.

eventPlaceStage.description: Stage use of an event place. All event-specific display data belongs to the containing place, and persistent identity is optional.

category.description: The organizer-defined stage group used to divide the event schedule. Missing means the main schedule group.

color.description: The organizer's presentation color for this stage use. Missing means unspecified, without inheritance from a persistent stage.

icon.description: A platform-neutral fallback icon for this stage when no logo is available.

lineup.description: Ordered organizer-authored contributor records in this event place's stage lineup, including performers without a scheduled program item.

shortLabel.description: Short fallback text for this stage when no logo or icon is available.

sortIndex.description: The event-wide stage display order. A program's eventPlaces array separately controls its lane order.

stage.description: An optional DID-based events.openmusic.stage record URI for continuity across editions. This is a live identity reference, not required rendering data or proof of the stage owner's agreement. Linking or unlinking it preserves the event place's identity.

externalMedia.description: Media hosted outside AT Protocol, represented as a portable link card without a closed provider list.

description.description: Additional human-readable context about the linked media.

mediaKind.description: The kind of media at the external URL.

thumbnail.description: An image used to preview the linked media.

title.description: A short human-readable title for the linked media.

uri.description: The public HTTPS URL of the external media.

focalPoint.description: A whole-percentage point in the source image, measured from its top-left before orientation correction.

x.description: The horizontal percentage from the source image's left edge.

y.description: The vertical percentage from the source image's top edge.

heroImage.description: An image intended as the primary visual for its subject.

iconImage.description: A compact image intended to represent its subject.

canRepresentSubjectWithoutLabel.description: Whether a client may use this rendered icon without adjacent visible subject-name text. Missing or false means the visible name remains present.

image.description: An image attached to an Open Music Event record.

alt.description: A text alternative that conveys the image's meaningful content. An omitted value means no text alternative was supplied.

appearance.description: The interface appearance for which this image variant is intended.

focalPoint.description: The preferred focal point to preserve when the image is cropped.

renderingMode.description: How clients should render the image. Defaults to original when omitted.

role.description: The image's intended use in an event experience.

source.description: The image content, provided as either a repository blob or a public HTTPS URL.

title.description: A short attendee-facing title for this image use, such as the name of a selectable map layer.

imageBlob.description: Image content stored as a blob in the repository that contains the referencing record.

blob.description: A JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, or AVIF image blob.

imageURL.description: Image content hosted at a public HTTPS URL.

url.description: The public HTTPS URL from which the image can be retrieved.

link.description: A public link with optional presentation and purpose metadata.

description.description: Additional human-readable context about the link.

platform.description: The known external platform that hosts the linked resource.

role.description: The link's purpose in the event experience.

title.description: A short human-readable label for the link.

url.description: The URI opened by this link.

location.description: A place associated with the event, with an optional name, machine-readable locators, and public links.

description.description: Event-specific information about this location, such as arrival guidance or an announcement status.

links.description: External pages for this location, such as map-provider or venue links.

locators.description: Machine-readable identifiers or coordinates for this location.

name.description: The organizer's human-readable name for this event location.

logoImage.description: An image intended as its subject's logo or wordmark.

mapStyle.description: One named base-map image with a stable identity inside its event. Renaming or reordering the style preserves its identity.

id.description: A stable event-local style identifier, independent of its title and array position.

image.description: The base image for this map style. Local asset paths and cache policy are not part of the public image.

mediaRecord.description: A live reference to an independently published AT Protocol media record. The record keeps its own identity, lifecycle, and social activity.

uri.description: The DID-based URI of the referenced media record. This is a live identity reference rather than a CID-pinned revision.

posterImage.description: An image intended as a promotional poster.

programCredit.description: One organizer-authored credit for a program item. The display name keeps the item renderable without dereferencing another repository.

billing.description: How prominently this contributor is billed. Defaults to primary when omitted.

contributor.description: The optional DID-based URI of this event's organizer-authored events.openmusic.contributor record.

name.description: The organizer-owned display name for this credit.

role.description: The contributor's role in this program item.

reportingLink.description: A channel for reporting a safety, conduct, or operational concern.

use.description: Whether this reporting channel is intended for an active emergency or a non-emergency matter.

semanticIcon.description: A platform-neutral name for a familiar pictogram. Values describe the depicted object or gesture, not the purpose assigned to it by a product.

siteMap.description: An event's selectable site-map presentation. Styles have stable event-local identities and organizer-defined display order.

defaultStyleID.description: The stable identifier of the default style. It must identify a style in this map.

styles.description: Ordered selectable map styles. The first style is the default when no defaultStyleID is supplied.

siteMapImage.description: An image intended as a site-map base layer.

ticketsLink.description: A page where attendees can obtain admission or tickets.

time.description: An exact instant used for an event schedule boundary.

value.description: The exact event boundary as an AT Protocol datetime.

websiteLink.description: The event or subject's primary website.
